nodes.name: Log: Ingest Failed
nodes.notes:
GENERATED — do not edit here. Source: n8n/intake-logging/logging/ingest-failed.node.js (+ _prelude.js)

POST /ingest returned an error after 2 tries (401/403 = Plexa Webhook Secret credential, 503 = WEBHOOK_SECRET unset on Vercel, 5xx/timeout = the service). Nothing was classified; the email has no label and will not be re-polled. Red, always.

nodes.name: Log: Intake Result
nodes.notes:
GENERATED — do not edit here. Source: n8n/intake-logging/logging/intake-result.node.js (+ _prelude.js)

Every processed email, the moment the service answers, in parallel with "Needs attention?". Replaced the old "Build log" → "Slack log" webhook post on 2026-10-20. Red = Manual Review, Yellow = lead the service chose not to answer (follow-up, cooldown, max replies, kill switch), Green = reply awaiting approval, JUNK, duplicate.

nodes.name: Log: Reply Declined
nodes.notes:
GENERATED — do not edit here. Source: n8n/intake-logging/logging/reply-declined.node.js (+ _prelude.js)

Declined in Slack, or the 24 h approval wait ran out. Nothing sent. Replaced the old "Slack declined" webhook post on 2026-10-20. "Label Processed" is reached directly from "Approved?" FALSE, not through this node, so a logging fault can never leave an email unlabelled. Yellow.

nodes.name: Log: Reply Failed
nodes.notes:
GENERATED — do not edit here. Source: n8n/intake-logging/logging/reply-failed.node.js (+ _prelude.js)

Gmail refused to send an APPROVED reply. The success path (Label Processed → match hand-off) does not run for this item, so nothing downstream pretends it was sent. Red: someone approved an answer that never left.

nodes.name: Log: Hand-off
nodes.notes:
GENERATED — do not edit here. Source: n8n/intake-logging/logging/hand-off.node.js (+ _prelude.js)

End of an approved lead: fed by BOTH outputs of "HTTP Request" (the POST to Property Matching). Green: reply sent and match request accepted, or nothing to match. Red: the POST failed — the requester was promised a match that never started. Property Matching logs its own stages after this.

nodes.name: Match ready?
nodes.notes: Added 2026-10-20 by n8n/intake-logging. Only approved leads reach here (the "If" before it). TRUE: match.request exists → POST to Property Matching. FALSE: Tier 3, nothing to match → "Log: Hand-off" still posts the Green "reply sent, no match request was built". Before this node every approved reply POSTed, with a null body for Tier 3.
